prerequisites: 100% presence at all 4 laboratory training courses
passing ungraded assessment test at end of term.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquaintance of students with basic structural and mechanical properties of materials, phase transformations and equilibrium diagrams.

syllabus_topics: Introduction (history, use of materials, outlooks, technical, economical and environmental aspects, significance of materials science course)
Theoretical fundamentals of materials science (atomic and molecular structure, interatomic and intermolecular bonds)
Crystal lattices and their defects, Miller indices
Mechanical properties and their testing (special emphasis on - fracture mechanics, fatigue, creep and relaxation)
Introductory lesson, safety instructions for laboratories
Cast iron tests and credit test
bibliography: CALLISTER, W.D.,Jr. Material science and engineering: An introduction, J.Willey & sons, N.Y., 1994 (In English)
SHACKELFORD, J.F. Intrduction to Materials Science for Engineers, Pearson, 2021 (In English)
MACEK, K. a kol. Nauka o materiálu cvičení
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
